messages:
Aisha: Hey @product/devrel — I want to trial a small experiment: route ~30% of inbound DP signups into a lighter 'tributary' onboarding that skips the full kickoff, asks for a 2-min feedback form + optional 20m call, and offers a $75 stipend. Goal: capture folks who bounce from our standard DP funnel and see if we can convert them to active trials. Thoughts?
Rob: Love the name. Quick Q — what’s the hypothesis and the primary metric? 7-day active or something else?
Aisha: Primary = 7-day active usage (opened app + 1 API call). Secondary = 30-day retention. Hypothesis: lower friction + small stipend will lift 7-day active by ~15% for the marginal pool.
Leah: How are we filtering who gets routed to tributary? We shouldn’t invite clearly low-fit leads. Suggest: only applicants with intake score >=3 OR self-reported org size >10k MAU.
Sam: Ops flag — we need a clear CRM tag so CS/Success know they’re on a tributary path. Also need a payout flow for the $75.
Aisha: Plan: metadata tags: label=tributary_2026Q1, onboarding_path=tributary. CS weekly digest to highlight these. We'll add a `tributary` filter to the DP dashboard.
Rob: Timeline: run for 4 weeks with weekly checkpoints. Can we A/B against the standard DP flow (randomized split)?
Leah: A/B is necessary. Random 30% -> tributary / 70% -> control full DP. Also tweak the screener: compress to 6 questions, swap Q4 to "primary use case" + short 2-sentence problem prompt.
Aisha: Draft outreach for tributary participants: "Hi — thanks for signing up! We’d love 20 minutes to show a lightweight preview and collect 5 quick prompts. We’ll also offer $75. Book here: <calendly_link> and fill this 2-min form: <short_form_link>". Keep it casual, emphasize speed. :sparkles:
Sam: Regarding incentives — $75 ok. Payout options? Stripe transfer preferred; fallback Amazon gc. Ops-bot, can you create a payout ticket?
Ops-bot: Created ticket #5213: https://tracker/5213 — build payout workflow + Stripe onboarding for tributary incentives.
Rob: Success criteria proposal: (1) 7-day active delta vs control >= +12%, AND (2) qualitative signal: >=60% of collected feedback items tagged as "actionable" by PM triage. If both hit, we escalate to a broader pilot.
Aisha: Add safety stop: if support ticket rate from tributary cohort >10% of cohort in a week, pause the flow. Also if median NPS from the form <= 0.
Sam: Measurement plan: emit events `tributary_onboarded`, `tributary_first_api_call`. Analytics to produce weekly cohort report (conversion, retention, support volume).
Leah: I’ll own the screener changes and email copy. Rob — can you wire the feature flag + dashboard views?
Rob: On it. I’ll add a LaunchDarkly flag `experiments.tributary_2026q1` and a GA cohort with the `tributary_2026q1` tag. Will post the dashboard link by EOD tomorrow.
Aisha: Nice. Next steps: Leah — copy + screener; Rob — flags + dashboard; Sam — CRM label + coordinate payout ticket; Ops-bot — track #5213; CS weekly digest owner = Aisha. Checkpoint: Tue 10am next week. :rocket:
Leah: ack
Sam: ack
Rob: ack
CS-Bot: Reminder set for 2026-01-20 10:00 for the check-in (auto-reminder).
